projects.title: ShopSphere — Full-Stack MERN E-Commerce
projects.tagline: High-performance digital marketplace with real-time inventory, Stripe payments, and admin analytics.
projects.description: A production-grade e-commerce application built on the MERN stack with JWT authentication, Redux Toolkit state management, order tracking, and a comprehensive seller analytics dashboard.
projects.longDescription: ShopSphere was engineered to solve high-concurrency cart synchronization and real-time inventory updates. Built using React on the frontend with custom Tailwind UI components, Express REST APIs on Node.js, and MongoDB with compound indexes for instant sub-20ms product searches.
features: JWT Authentication & Role-Based Access Control (Admin / Vendor / Customer)
MongoDB Aggregation Pipelines for daily sales & conversion analytics
Real-time inventory deduction with atomic transaction handling
Instant search and faceted filtering across categories and price ranges
Fully responsive checkout flow optimized for mobile conversions
projects.dbSchemaSummary: Collections: users, products, orders, categories, reviews. Indexed on product title, slug, and vendorId.

projects.title: DevPulse — Developer Collaboration Hub
projects.tagline: Real-time collaborative developer platform for sharing code snippets, repository architecture, and sprint reviews.
projects.description: Full-stack platform empowering engineering teams to share syntax-highlighted snippets, engage in threaded technical discussions, and review pull requests collaboratively.
projects.longDescription: DevPulse enables teams to create modular engineering workspaces. Features rich markdown parsing, interactive code run preview, granular team permissions, and optimized MongoDB document nesting for high-speed discussion rendering.
features: Live syntax highlighting with instant multi-language formatting
MongoDB threaded comment architecture with parent-child references
Real-time notifications via lightweight WebSocket events
GitHub OAuth and personal access token repository synchronization
Clean dark-mode interface built for prolonged developer focus
projects.metrics: 150+ Daily Active Users · 1.2s Page Load · 100% Mobile Ready
projects.dbSchemaSummary: Collections: users, workspaces, snippets, discussions, tags. Compound index on (workspaceId, createdAt).

projects.title: TaskFlow — Agile Kanban Workflow Manager
projects.tagline: Streamlined project tracking with drag-and-drop boards, sprint planning, and team velocity metrics.
projects.description: An agile task management solution engineered for rapid sprint execution. Provides interactive drag-and-drop reordering, assignee filtering, and instant MongoDB state synchronization.
projects.longDescription: Built to streamline sprint ceremonies. Utilizes optimized MongoDB arrays with positional updates (`$set`, `$position`) for sub-millisecond task column shifts, combined with optimistic UI updates in React.
features: Fluid Drag and Drop task board with optimistic client-side feedback
Custom workflows: Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Review, Blocked, Done
MongoDB atomic positional updates for priority reordering
Sprint velocity calculation and burndown chart analytics
Export sprint summary to JSON / CSV format
projects.metrics: 60 FPS Interactions · Zero Stutter Drag & Drop · 100% Type-Safe
projects.dbSchemaSummary: Collections: boards, columns, tasks, sprints. Subdocument indexing for ultra-fast column rendering.

projects.title: StreamSync — Video & Media Streaming Platform
projects.tagline: Modern media platform with adaptive bit-rate playback, creator channels, and real-time interaction.
projects.description: A responsive video sharing and streaming application featuring user channel management, video metadata indexing, custom playlists, and live stream notifications.
projects.longDescription: StreamSync is designed with high-throughput video metadata streaming in mind. Uses MongoDB GridFS and CDN-backed storage references, with optimized pagination and video recommendation algorithms.
features: Custom HTML5 video player with keyboard shortcuts and playback speed control
Channel subscriptions, video liking, and nested comments
MongoDB cursor-based infinite scroll pagination for feed performance
Responsive video grid layout with dark mode first aesthetics
Video tag search with fuzzy matching indexing
projects.metrics: 450k+ Mock Views · Adaptive Streaming · <150ms API Latency
projects.dbSchemaSummary: Collections: videos, channels, comments, playlists. MongoDB text indexes on title and description.

reviews.name: David Reynolds
reviews.content: Suhail is one of the most reliable MERN developers I have had the privilege to work with. He architected our Express backend and MongoDB aggregation pipelines with phenomenal speed and precision. His clean UI work with React and Tailwind made our client presentations seamless.

reviews.name: Sarah Chen
reviews.content: Working with Suhail was effortless. He has an intuitive grasp of both frontend reactivity and robust backend data handling. He turned complex MongoDB multi-collection queries into snappy API responses under 30ms. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Marcus Vance
reviews.content: Suhail built our MVP from scratch in record time. From initial schema modeling in MongoDB to pixel-perfect responsive Tailwind pages that look gorgeous on both mobile and 4K displays, he exceeded all expectations.
